verdict.rationale: Extend's extraction docs say every run returns per-field confidence scores and citations that point back to the exact spot on the page, and multifile extraction covers file provenance. This is first-party, field-level provenance, but the evidence never itemizes the citation contents. missing for 10: explicit documentation that each citation includes page number, bounding-box coordinates and a source text snippet, plus independent hands-on corroboration of citation accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, every extracted field carries provenance — page number, bounding box, source snippet — so agents can cite and humans can verify
